pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown regions with moderately sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry consists of larger, elongated polygons on the lower neck and upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes posteriorly.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial space forming distinct tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line, showing a soft textural contrast against the background.
